_about: Machine-readable vocabulary of every AdvancedMD / Stedi API call the project has captured. ONE entry per call. docs/postman_effinger_amd.json is GENERATED from this file by tools/mirror/postman_build.py — edit here, never the collection. Never store a token, password, key, patient name or member number in this file.

variables.token: AMD usercontext token from login (never stored)

calls.name: Login step 1 — partnerlogin (returns webserver redirect)
calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="login" class="login" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" username="POI0712" psw="{{amd_password}}" officecode="152563" appname="TEMP"/>
calls.description: ONE ATTEMPT ONLY — a second failed login locks POI0712 and kills the Claimocity feed. Response carries webserver="..."; repeat the same body against <webserver>/xmlrpc/processrequest.aspx to get <usercontext>TOKEN</usercontext>. Token = {{token}} everywhere else.

calls.name: Login step 2 — webserver (returns usercontext token)
calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="login" class="login" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" username="POI0712" psw="{{amd_password}}" officecode="152563" appname="TEMP"/>
calls.description: Same body as step 1, posted to the webserver returned by step 1. success="1" + <usercontext> = token.

calls.name: Check eligibility (EligibilityDetailsLegacy) — full 271
calls.description: Synchronous; returns PPMDResults/Results + Edi271. No AAA = active. Medicare needs the HEET attestation (UID VQAS).

calls.name: Edit address (familyupdate) — PATCH
calls.description: Captured from William's Edit-address click 9/7/2026. William's placeholder rule: HCA / SNF / ALF on line 1, zip 32308-4486. GOTCHA (9/11): returns HTTP 500 'Email is not a valid format' and saves NOTHING when the chart's contact email holds junk (phone numbers seen in email on old charts) — send email:"" (or a valid address) inside the same updatedpatient.
calls.helper: patient_patch.family_address(pid, address1, address2, zip, city, state)

calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="getdemographic" class="demographics" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" patientid="pat{{patientid}}" nocookie="1"><usercontext>{{token}}</usercontext></ppmdmsg>

calls.name: getchargedetaildataicd10 (by charge id)
calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="getchargedetaildataicd10" class="demographics" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" chargeid="{{chargeid}}" nocookie="1"><usercontext>{{token}}</usercontext></ppmdmsg>
calls.description: By CHARGE id only; visitid= returns nothing for new visits. Returns ONLY the one charge asked for — see the void trap.

calls.name: addinsurance — add a plan (NO group number)
calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="addinsurance" class="demographics" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" ><usercontext>{{token}}</usercontext><patient id="pat{{patientid}}" changed="1"><insplanlist><insplan id="" begindate="{{begindate}}" carrier="car{{carrierid}}" subscriber="resp{{respid}}" subscribernum="{{membernum}}" hipaarelationship="18" relationship="1" grpname="" grpnum="" coverage="1"/></insplanlist></patient></ppmdmsg>
calls.description: Returns new ins id + sequence. William's rule (8/31): grpnum and grpname ALWAYS empty. VA member id = ICN, never SSN. Carrier ids in practices/ehpa/carriers.json.

calls.name: updateinsurance — change one plan field (wrapped shape)
calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="updateinsurance" class="demographics" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" ><usercontext>{{token}}</usercontext><patient id="pat{{patientid}}" changed="1"><insplanlist><insplan id="ins{{insid}}" enddate="{{new}}" o_enddate="{{old}}"/></insplanlist></patient></ppmdmsg>
calls.description: Send ONLY the changed field plus its o_<field> original; echoing every attribute fails 'Another user has changed this insurance record'. The bare unwrapped <insplan/> child can fault 'Value can not be null' (9/8). The `sequence` attribute is NOT the plan's number here - AMD reads it as the PATIENT's insurance ORDER (insorder): sequence="2,1" sets Medicare-first; echoing a plan's own sequence on any other edit resets the patient order to that one plan (9/14/2026, pat17472393: a begin-date edit turned insorder 4,3 into 4). ins_update.update() drops it unless passed.

calls.name: lookuppatient — find a chart
calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="lookuppatient" class="api" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" name="%{{lastname}}%" exactmatch="0" page="1"><usercontext>{{token}}</usercontext></ppmdmsg>
calls.description: The only patient search that works from the API. %wildcard% lookups.

calls.name: DOB / flat fields — PATCH (familyupdate null)
calls.body:
{
 "updatedpatient": "<flat patient with the changed field>",
 "originalpatient": "<the GET result, unchanged>",
 "updateaccounttype": false,
 "familyupdate": null,
 "deleteappointments": false
}
calls.description: Same PATCH as Edit address but without the familyupdate block.

calls.name: updvisitwithcharges — FULL-ECHO resave (void trap!)
calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="updvisitwithcharges" class="chargeentry" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" ><usercontext>{{token}}</usercontext><visit id="vst{{visitid}}" patient="pat{{patientid}}" insorder="{{insorder}}" refplan="{{refplan}}" preauth="{{preauth}}" facility="fac{{facilityid}}" force="1" approval="1" inspectorenabled="1" batchid=""><chargelist><charge id="charge{{chargeid}}" ...EVERY ACTIVE CHARGE OF THE VISIT, ALL ATTRIBUTES ECHOED... modcodes="mcode7"><diagcodelist><diagcode id="{{numeric dcode id}}"/></diagcodelist></charge></chargelist></visit></ppmdmsg>
calls.description: REPLACES the visit's charge list with what you send — any charge omitted is VOIDED (30 charges lost 9/2–9/3). Build from resave.visit_charges(chargeid); never echo a single-charge detail on a multi-charge visit. diagcodes= attr is silently IGNORED for edits — dx saves only via the nested <diagcodelist> child with NUMERIC ids (9/8). modcodes = mcode ids (25 = mcode7). insorder = comma list of plan SEQUENCE numbers. refplan/preauth repoint the visit to a referral plan and write the auth onto it (and onto the previous plan — process the stay keeping the original plan LAST).
calls.helper: resave.py, recode._save(cid, fn), move_to_ins.move(cid, seq), amdw.resave_visit

calls.name: updextrainsinfo — frequency reset (always original) / hospitalization dates
calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="updextrainsinfo" class="chargeentry" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" visitid="vst{{visitid}}"><usercontext>{{token}}</usercontext><extins txtChargeCode="" resubmissioncode="1" origrefnum="" hospitalizationfrom="{{admitdate}}" hospitalizationto="{{dischargedate}}"/></ppmdmsg>
calls.description: Run BEFORE every rebill: resubmissioncode=1 origrefnum='' (William 9/3 — never frequency 7 unless he hands you the payer ICN). Same call sets the hospitalization (admit) dates the Inspector wants. NEVER send hospitalizationto (standing flag).

calls.name: addreferralplan — one referral plan per VA stay
calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="addreferralplan" class="chargeentry" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" ><usercontext>{{token}}</usercontext><refplan id="" patient="pat{{patientid}}" ismain="0" status="stat1" preauthreq="0" sequence="2" refprov="rprov{{refprovid}}" type="I" reason="SELF-REFERRAL" preauth="" begindate="" enddate="" maxvisits="0" usedvisits="0" maxamount="" usedamount="0" proccode="" diagcodes="" facility=""/></ppmdmsg>
calls.description: Creates a BLANK plan and returns its rplan id (attribute values largely ignored). Without ismain/status it get-or-returns the existing main plan. Then resave each visit with refplan="rplanX" preauth="VAxxxx" to link + write the auth. VA auths live on referral plans, not the encounter.

calls.description: Same message with every amount "0" = Process Accepted ($0.00). Post the payment line of an unvalidated ERA, never the $0 denial line (9/6 error, fixed 9/7). SWEEP RULE (9/21/2026): a posterapayments call for ONE visit (FORCE_VISITS) is not isolated - AMD's engine went on to post 29 other claims of check 819814877, each capped at its visit's open balance (the leftover PR2, e.g. $17.50 for a $68.62 line) on visits that still carried hand posts; never Post a single visit of a check while other claims of that check sit on hand-posted / partially-open visits - void those first or use the ERA-linked addpayments (payreasons.post_line); audit the charts afterwards (payreasons.py --audit --since-payid).

Then updextrainsinfo resubmissioncode=1 + chargerebill on the target plan's OWN sequence (getdemographic insplanlist, never insorder[0]). prof13 = Effinger (rendering NPI 1225327380, billing = group NPI 1629515325).

calls.body:
<!-- addpayments class=paymententry writeoff code="{{wocode}}" (manual_post.post(cid, carrier, 0, amount, wocode, note=...)).
AMD MASTER FILE - every write-off code (William pasted the list 9/12/2026):
 #WORU       WRITE OFF - SAME DAY ROLLUP
 ADJCAP      WRITE OFF - CAP
 ADJRISK     WRITE OFF - RISK/RETENTION
 PROMPT      PROMPT
 WOAPPEAL    WRITE OFF - AFTER APPEAL DENIED
 WOAREXH     WRITE OFF - AR EXHAUSTED
 WOBAD       WRITE OFF - BAD DEBT
 WOBANK      WRITE OFF - BANKRUPTCY
 WOCAID2ND   WRITE OFF - MEDICAID [member id] AFTER MEDICARE
 WOCLTREQ    CLIENT REQUEST, AUTHORIZATION SUBMITTED
 WOCLTREQ1X  WRITE OFF - CLIENT REQUEST AUTH 1X
 WOCOLL      WRITE OFF - COLLECTIONS
 WOCOUR      WRITE OFF - COURTESY
 WOENDCOLLA  WRITE OFF - END OF PATIENT COLLECTIONS
 WOFILE      WRITE OFF - RECEIVED CHARGE AFTER FILING
 WOFIN       WRITE OFF - FINANCIAL DIFFICULTY
 WOGLOB      WRITE OFF - GLOBAL DURING POST OP PERIOD
 WOINCL      WRITE OFF - INCLUSIVE
 WOINFO      WRITE OFF - REQD INFO NOT RECD FROM CLIENT
 WOINS       WRITE OFF - INSURANCE
 WOINSBANK   WRITE OFF - INS BANKRUPTCY
 WOLATE      WRITE OFF - LATE FILING DEDUCTION
 WOMCAD      WRITE OFF - MEDICAID
 WOMISC      WRITE OFF - MISC
 WONCS       WRITE OFF - NON COVERED SERVICES
 WOPD90+AR   WRITE OFF - PD TRANSFER INSURANCE BALANCE
 WOPD90+PB   WRITE OFF - PD TRANSFER PATIENT BALANCE
 WOPDEOB     WRITE OFF - CL PD EOB NOT FWRD TO MBS
 WORTNADD    WRITE OFF - RETURNED PATIENT ADDRESS
 WOSMBAL     WRITE OFF - SMALL BALANCE
 WOSTATE     WRITE OFF - STATE SUPPLIED VACCINE

HOW THE RUNS PICK (William 9/7, 9/11, 9/12):
 WOINS      untimely / never-adjudicated PRIMARY over 12 months from DOS (dated note)
 WOLATE     payer denied untimely (CO29/PI29), no proof of timely filing
 WONCS      non-covered service (CO96/PR96; CCM billed Medicaid-primary)
 WOCAID2ND  dual: Medicaid secondary residual after Medicare/MA paid (crossover $0)
 WOMCAD     residual on a Medicaid-PRIMARY charge
 WOSMBAL    small balance under $25 per patient
 WOBAD      patient no-pay / bad debt after one statement cycle; WOFIN financial difficulty; WORTNADD statement returned, no address
 WOAPPEAL   after an appeal is denied; WOAREXH every payer and the patient exhausted
 WOINSBANK  parking write-off later voided when the balance goes back to insurance
 WOCLTREQ   a write-off William directs in chat / on the board with no better-fitting code ('client request'); prefer the more descriptive code when one fits (William 9/12)
 WOCOUR     courtesy - NEVER across the board on Medicare/MA cost-sharing
 WOMISC / WOINCL / WOGLOB / WOFILE / WOINFO / WOPDEOB / WOPD90+AR / WOPD90+PB / WOENDCOLLA / WOSTATE / WOBANK / ADJCAP / ADJRISK / #WORU / PROMPT: in the master file, not yet used by a run - ask before using. -->
calls.description: Not a call: the complete write-off code list from AMD Master Files (William 9/12/2026) plus the rule for picking one. Every run posting a write-off picks from here and writes a dated note; new codes or rules go here and in practices/ehpa/rules.md.

calls.name: Availity Remittance Viewer PDF exports -> check register -> manual posts (data source, no HTTP call)
calls.body:
<!-- NOT an API call: a remit SOURCE captured 9/15/2026. William exports Florida Blue / Health Options checks from Availity Remittance Viewer (Print -> PDF) into Drive 'bht Optum era downloads' as CheckDetails-<ts>.pdf (one check), CheckMultipleDetails-<ts>.pdf (several) and ClaimDetails-<ts>.pdf (one claim). They are print views, not 835s: era_upload.py cannot load them.
Parse: pypdf text; Check Summary page = payer (line before 'Payee Tax ID'), Check/EFT Trace Number, Payment Amount, Check/EFT Date; each Claim Summary page = Claim Number, Patient ID (member), Claim Date, Patient Control Number = AMD visit id + claim letter, Claim Charge/Payment, Patient Responsibility, Claim Status Code (1 primary processed, 22 reversal); line block after 'Charge Adj (Qty) Adj Amount Payment' = Line Ctrl Nmbr (= AMD charge id), DOS, HC:<CPT>//<units>, remark codes, charge (B6 = allowed), adjustments CO-xx/PR-xx $, payment last.
Scripts (billing/era): avail_checks_parse.py -> registers/availity_checks_<stamp>.json (dedupe by trace); avail_vs_amd.py -> GET /api/era/checks text search + gettxhistory payment checknumber per charge -> registers/availity_vs_amd_<stamp>.json (missing = money not in AMD); avail_post.py -> manual_post.post(cid, 'BCBS', pay=min(paid, live insbalance), wo=CO adjustments capped, 'WOINS', checknumber=trace, depositdate=check date) per missing line, register key <trace>|<chargeid> in registers/era_manual_register.json, stop after 3 addpayments faults. -->

The payer ICN is read from the charge itself: getchargedetaildataicd10 by charge id -> the ERA-posted <payment origrefnum="..." checknumber="..."> element (era checkdetails JSON never exposes it). Then POST /api/claim/chargerebill sequencenumber=<plan seq> -> 204; readback shows resubmissioncode=7 origrefnum=<ICN> insbilled=0. Proven 9/15/2026 on pat17473476 (Florida Blue CO-22 $0 denial, WOINS voided first, member id corrected).

calls.name: addpayments - ERA-linked manual post WITH reason codes (Payment Entry 'post manually')
calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="addpayments" class="paymententry" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" useopenedge="1" checkout="0" date="" nocookie="1"><usercontext>{{token}}</usercontext><patient patientid="pat{{patientid}}" paysource="2" postingmethod="era" amount="{{pay}}" paycode="PE" woamount="{{wo}}" paymethod="9" carrierid="car{{carrierid}}" depositdate="{{depositdate}}" eraclaimid="{{checkclaimid}}" erareportid="{{checkid}}" case_note="" checknumber="{{checknumber}}" inclstmt="0" postedby="POI0712" batch=""><unappliedpaymentlist/><unappliedwriteofflist/><chargelist><charge id="charge{{chargeid}}" allowed="{{allowed}}" insportion="{{insportion}}" patportion="{{patportion}}" insbalance="{{insbalance}}" patbalance="{{patbalance}}" profile="prof{{profileid}}"><paymentlist><payment amount="{{pay}}" id="" reason="CO45" status="B"><reasonlist payment="{{pay}}" allowed="{{allowed}}"><reason id="{{reportreasondetailid}}" reasonid="{{payreasonid}}" code="CO45" name="Charge exceeds fee schedule/maximum allowable or contracted/legislated fee arrangement." amount="{{co45}}" units="0" group="CO"/><reason id="{{reportreasondetailid}}" reasonid="370" code="PR2" name="Coinsurance Amount" amount="{{pr2}}" units="0" group="PR"/></reasonlist></payment></paymentlist><writeofflist><writeoff id="" risk="0" amount="{{wo}}" code="WOINS" status="B"/></writeofflist></charge></chargelist></patient></ppmdmsg>
calls.description: The ONLY addpayments shape that keeps reason codes on the payment (proven 9/21/2026 on 54 visits, Medicare 819814877 and eight 2024 checks): postingmethod=era + eraclaimid/erareportid + the remit's <reasonlist> with the era_details ids (reason id = reportreasondetailid, reasonid = payreasonid, e.g. CO45 107, PR2 370, CO253 34913). Plain addpayments (postingmethod='' / manual_post.post) silently drops every reason -> 'Payment reason codes are missing or do not balance' holds the secondary. Amounts: pay = the remit's paid (capped at the open insurance balance), wo = the CO/OA/PI adjustments capped so pay+wo <= balance (WOINS; WOLATE CO-29; WONCS CO-96/204/50), PR amounts stay on the visit for the next payer. Works while the check is dismissed or processed (the ids come from the era_details cache). Synchronous and per patient - never sweeps the check the way the Post button can. Reply: <Results success="1" paymentid="NNN"/>.

calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="void" class="void" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" patientid="pat{{patientid}}" nocookie="1"><usercontext>{{token}}</usercontext><patient id="pat{{patientid}}"><charge id="{{chargeid}}" void="0"><payment id="{{paymentid}}"/></charge></patient></ppmdmsg>
calls.description: payreasons.py --unbilled --live (9/21/2026): for each Unbilled row of this class - (1) gettxhistory: the live payments with no <payreason> children on the visit's charges; (2) void each (this call) and the write-off posted with it (same createtime; void_tx.void_writeoff) and any $0 code-less line; (3) find the ERA claim behind it (register -> checkid, else the payment's check number in GET /api/era/checks or /api/era/checks/dismiss); a dismissed check is restored with reversedismiss so checkdetails answers, then dismissed again; a processed check's lines come from the era_details/<checkid>.json cache; (4) post the line again with the ERA-linked addpayments (previous entry); (5) read the chart back: on every live payment |paid| + reason amounts == fee; (6) hideunbillablevisits hide=-1 with the NUMERIC visit id. 54/54 rows repaired 9/21 05:45-06:20 UTC; Unbilled 55 -> 1.
